1. Title & Inclusions Matching Protocol (Zero False Positives)

Scan Target: Line Item Name and Inclusions Only. Exclusions and metadata boilerplate ("NA") are ignored.
Clean Panelling Rule: Standard laminate panellings without premium finishes or high unit rates remain strictly Standard scope.

2. Universal Area Rate Rule

Unit Rate > ₹2000 on SqFt / RFt area intensity automatically triggers Specialised Scope and Specialist Trade Partner Allocation.

3. Sourcing Allocation Policies

Specialist Trade Vendor Allocation Required
Triggered when any line item is Specialised Scope or Rate > ₹2k Override.
Routes to qualified specialist vendor pool (Duco/PU/Veneer, Waterproofing, Heavy Load, Concealed Loop).
Standard Contractor Pool Dispatch
Triggered when all line items in the BoQ are 100% Standard scope and rates are within standard bands.
Dispatches to standard trade contractor pool via automated assignment.
